conventions.lp_trig: 1-min bins -120..+360 min from LP onset; baseline mean(-120,-30) subtracted
conventions.peaks: extrema of 2-min rolling mean in [LP onset, +240 min], latency from onset
conventions.onset_triggered: >=5-min quiescence onsets, cap 400 (rng 42), full-record z dF, peri_event 1-s bins -60..180, baseline -60..-10
conventions.earlylate: >=10-min onsets, base(-60,-10)->peak(0,60) deltas, behavioral-clock CT (CT12 at onset), early CT12-18 / late CT18-24, subsample 250 (rng 1)
conventions.gfp_rule: GFP is a sensor class — own labeled series everywhere, never pooled
